opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA) Opportunity: Research Travel Bursaries

next_open_date.raw: Further rounds of bursaries will be offered.

amount.raw: The travel bursary provides up to £250, to help cover transport, accommodation and reasonable expenses.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: You need to be a Member of ERBA to apply for this opportunity.
opportunities.summary: The bursary is intended to support a specific research-related trip, such as visiting a gallery, museum, collection, or site, or meeting with a key contact or attending an event related to the research.
